predecessors.name: Kievan Rus'
predecessors.text: Terebovlia, an appanage cut from the Rus' lands; the page's infobox says 'Preceded by: Kievan Rus''

successors.name: Principality of Halych
successors.text: Cliopatria's shape plus the land round Terebovlia itself, which the gazetteer puts 27 km outside the drawn band

ledger.x: 1084: Terebovlia is established as an appanage for Vasylko Rostyslavych.
1094: Cliopatria widens the principality south and east over Podolia and the Dniester-Prut lands (+43,000 km2).
1124: Vasylko Rostyslavych dies and his son Rostyslav-Hryhoriy succeeds.
1141: Terebovlia is united with Zvenyhorod and Peremyshl in the Principality of Galicia.
1141: the Rostyslavych line's principality ends in the union.

wars.name: War after the blinding of Vasylko Rostyslavych
wars.outcome: David Igorevich and Sviatopolk II captured and blinded Vasylko in November 1097, which broke the Liubech agreements and brought war; the page gives no result for Terebovlia.

certainty.note: No treaty or survey line on the pages opened; the frontiers with Hungary, Peremyshl and the steppe are approximate throughout.
